Job Description

As an Equipment Engineer within the EGIO area, you will be responsible for ensuring the technical availability, performance, and continuous improvement of highly complex production equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. Leveraging your expertise in implantation, epitaxy, glass-processing technologies, and furnace systems, you will play a key role in maintaining stable, quality-compliant, and cost-efficient manufacturing processes while meeting the highest standards of safety, quality, and productivity. Through proactive problem-solving, equipment optimization, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will contribute directly to manufacturing excellence, product quality, and the company's overall competitiveness.

You will join a highly skilled and interdisciplinary team of approximately 40 engineers, technicians, and support specialists. Our working environment is built on openness, trust, and collaborative teamwork, providing an atmosphere where technical expertise is valued, innovation is encouraged, and both professional and personal development can thrive.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Ownership

- Provide technical support, optimization, and further development of production equipment within the EGIO area (Epitaxy, Glass Processes, Implantation, and Furnaces).
- Ensure high equipment availability and process stability.
- Conduct fault analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Coordinate and oversee preventive maintenance and repair activities.

Process and Quality Optimization

- Analyze equipment and process data to identify improvement opportunities.
- Develop and implement initiatives to improve: - OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
- MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
- MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)
- Process Capability (Cp/Cpk)
- Yield and Product Quality
- Perform statistical analyses and root-cause investigations.
- Support the qualification of new processes, products, and equipment upgrades.

Project Management

- Lead and participate in cross-functional improvement projects.
- Plan and implement equipment upgrades and retrofit programs.
- Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and external service providers.
- Prepare technical specifications and requirement documents.

Production Support

- Support escalation management within the manufacturing environment.
- Deliver technical training for operators and maintenance technicians.

Other Responsibilities

- Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality standards.
- Maintain equipment performance in line with production targets.
- Reduce unplanned equipment downtime.
- Document technical modifications and engineering changes.
- Support audits and ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in one of the following disciplines:

- Electrical/ Mechanical/ Microsystems/Process Engineering
- Physics
- Materials Science
- Or a comparable technical field

Professional Experience

- Minimum 3 years of experience in the semiconductor industry or a comparable high-tech manufacturing environment.
- Practical experience in at least one of the EGIO responsibility areas.

Technical Expertise

- Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
- Knowledge of SPC (Statistical Process Control), FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and data analytics.
- Experience with MES and ERP systems.
- Familiarity with vacuum technology, high-temperature processes, gas delivery systems, and cleanroom technologies.
- Ability to interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and engineering specifications.

Personal Competencies

- Strong analytical and structured approach to problem-solving.
- High level of initiative and ownership.
- Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.
- Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.
- Resilience and flexibility in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
- Continuous Improvement mindset.

Language Skills

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain & Quality Manager - Cabin Seat  (f/m/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the SCQM Team, Airbus is looking for a

Supply Chain & Quality Manager - Cabin Seat (f/m/d)

Are You Ready to Define the Passenger Experience? When passengers step onto an Airbus aircraft, the first thing they look for, touch, and experience is their seat. Seating is where cutting-edge aerospace engineering meets customer-facing luxury and strict aviation safety.

We are seeking a high-energy, detail-oriented Supply Chain & Quality Manager (SCQM) to take the lead in managing the quality, compliance, and industrial readiness of our global cabin seating suppliers.

If you are a proactive manager who loves the thrill of fast-paced industrializations, custom designs, and zero-defect executions, this is your ultimate career destination!

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Act as focal point towards the suppliers for operational activities and contract management, and as ambassador of the supplier toward internal functions..
- Perform an effective control of supplier activities, securing a close understanding of the delivery and quality conformity of the product
- Implement recovery, improvement and development plan in order to secure delivery of the products and services in conformity covering quality, delivery.
- Coordinate the stakeholders involved in the supplier operations management and contribute to the corresponding Multi-Functional or Divisional Team (MFT) Manage/contribute to supplier On Quality On Time (OQOT) performance.
- Manage supplier quality Approval/Authorization, ensure that suppliers are compliant with certifications required in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
- Managing suppliers’ quality recoveries and following-up of the quality actions plan of the suppliers via root cause analysis (RCA) 9S / PPS problem solving methodologies

Desired skills and qualifications

Key Skills & Competencies

- Autonomy & Proactivity: High degree of autonomy, initiative, rigor, reactivity, and eagerness to learn
- Stakeholder Management & Collaboration: Strong cross-functional stakeholder management, effective team spirit, and working beyond functional boundaries
- Communication & Negotiation: Excellent communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills with the ability to resolve conflicts constructively
- Problem Solving & Risk Mitigation: Proven track record in solving quality problems, anticipating and mitigating risks, and managing uncertainty across complex scenarios

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

- Education: Engineering or other relevant technical degree. Professional Experience: At least 4 years of experience, ideally in Quality, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, or Production
- Domain Background: Industrial background—specifically in Manufacturing Engineering or Quality—is a strong plus. Experience in Cabin perimeter is highly appreciated
- Languages: Business/negotiation fluency in English; proficiency in French and/or German is an asset

- Duration: 12 months with the possibility to prolong the contract

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment.
- Fluent in German and English.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

AGGP2027 Graduate Engineering Planning & Data Manager

Start date - October 2027

Are you a university graduate with the aspiration, enthusiasm, and talent to help us pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world? Every year, Airbus seeks bright minds from around the globe to fill critical roles that will shape our future.

When you begin your career with us, we don't just offer a job; we accelerate your growth through the Airbus Global Graduate development journey. This isn't a one-size-fits-all program; it's a personalized, two-year experience designed to cultivate your professional skills, enhance your business acumen, and hone your technical abilities. We place a strong emphasis on developing your leadership potential from day one. You'll gain a unique perspective on the world of Airbus while contributing directly in a specific, impactful position.

During the two years, we will take you on a soft-skill development journey, covering such areas as inclusive leadership, our Values, resilience, communication and emotional intelligence, with various in-person and virtual workshops.

Beyond your daily responsibilities and this comprehensive schedule of training, you'll join your global graduate community annually for an in-person dedicated development week. This is your chance to connect with your peers, learn directly from our seasoned leaders, and gain insights from the best in the industry.

Throughout the programme, you will be developed into an established and valuable team member from day 1. You'll sharpen your skills in an area strategically important to Airbus, gaining a deep understanding of our business – its opportunities, challenges, and needs. Most importantly, you'll have learned more about yourself and what makes you truly great. You will have demonstrated your capability and readiness to take on future leadership challenges within Airbus.

Above all, you'll have the unparalleled opportunity to do your best work in an industry that is literally reshaping how we live in our world.

If you're ready to embark on this transformative journey and unlock your full potential, apply below.

As part of your application, PLEASE ATTACH A CV & COVER LETTER

What you will be doing

You will be on a development pathway to prepare you to be an Engineering Planning & Data Manager and can expect to be involved in the following:

- Plan and steer engineering customization activities within challenging projects to implement specific airline requests
- Performing Data Analytics tasks on the Airbus internal platform Skywise and other environments
- Contribute in shaping the future way of working while supporting digitalisation initiatives
- Unique possibility to get to know the aircraft customization from early definition up to certification and delivery, combining theory (processes and project management) and practice (manufacturing and delivery)
- gaining an insight in all the different areas involved in delivering a customised product with a focus on Cabin & Cargo

Your development pathway will include a minimum of one rotation on a different mission.

At the end of the 2 year development programme you will be fully equipped to be a key player as Engineering Planning & Data Manager.

What we look for

To be a successful applicant to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme, you will need to demonstrate you have:

- A degree level or equivalent within a relevant field of study
- Recently graduated or first professional experience in the field of engineering preferable with knowledge in data science or analytics
- Degree required: Bachelor degree
- Strong verbal and written communication in our business language (English)
- A desire to work in a collaborative team environment, focused on driving future innovation
- The ability to be self aware and a wish to be in the driving seat of your Development.
- Specific experience or interests: project management, strong communication skills, interested in digital trends and data oriented

Please note, we love your interest in working for Airbus but we do ask that you make only one application to the Airbus Global Graduate Programme. Intern (d/f/m) for Business Management Support

Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime) and EUR 750 gross/monthly salary.
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.

- Financial Insight: Hands-on involvement in project-level financial tracking and corporate financial alignment
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Direct interaction with key stakeholders across project management, operations, and commercial offer teams.
- Mentorship: Professional development support and continuous guidance from experienced operations managers and project leads.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Business & Project Management Support:

- Support Airframe Project Managers (APMs) in defining project scopes, objectives, and deliverables with sufficient detail.
- Track project progress against established timelines and key performance indicators (KPIs).
- Assist APMs in planning, coordinating, and executing uPDP milestones.

Offer Management & Administrative Support:

- Collaborate with Offer Managers (OMs) to gather, organize, and validate inputs required for commercial offers.
- Perform administrative tracking of new offer inflow requests to ensure timely processing and routing.
- Maintain central records and dashboards for incoming business inquiries and project proposals.

Financial & Performance Tracking:

- Support the Upgrade team in establishing and monitoring project-level financial trackers.
- Monitor budget vs. actuals, variance analysis, and expenditure trends across active projects.
- Maintain alignment between project-level financial tracking .

- Enrolled full-time student d/f/m) in the area of Business Administration, Business Management, Project Management, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or an equivalent field of study.
- Fluent in German and English.
- Proficiency in Google tools (sheets, slides, docs)
- Advanced Google sheets skills (data organization, lookup formulas, basic financial modeling) preferred.
- Familiarity with project management tools or ERP systems (e.g., SAP) is a plus.
